faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lede: Got questions about our services or development process? Here are clear answers to help you understand what to expect before starting your project.
faq.askBody: Let's discuss your requirements and explore the right digital solution for your business.

items.question: What services does AptenTech offer for digital product development?
items.answer: AptenTech provides web and mobile app development, custom software, AI solutions, UI/UX design, cloud development, and digital transformation services.

items.question: What industries and business types does AptenTech work with?
items.answer: AptenTech works with startups, growing businesses, enterprises, and organizations across industries with solutions tailored to their specific operational and customer needs.

items.question: Can AptenTech handle both new products and existing applications?
items.answer: Yes, AptenTech can build new digital products from scratch and improve existing applications through modernization, feature development, integrations, performance improvements, and ongoing support.

items.question: What technologies and development frameworks does AptenTech work with?
items.answer: AptenTech works with modern web, mobile, backend, cloud, AI, and database technologies selected according to your product requirements and technical goals.

items.question: How does AptenTech help businesses turn ideas into working digital products?
items.answer: AptenTech evaluates your idea, defines requirements, plans the product, designs user experiences, develops core functionality, integrates required technologies, and supports product launch.

items.question: What does the AptenTech development process look like from idea to launch?
items.answer: The process covers requirement discovery, planning, UI/UX design, development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support based on your product requirements.

items.question: How does AptenTech understand my requirements before starting development?
items.answer: Our team discusses your business goals, users, features, integrations, technical needs, and expected outcomes to create a clear development scope.

items.question: How is the development cost determined for a custom project?
items.answer: Project pricing depends on features, platforms, design requirements, integrations, technology choices, development complexity, and the level of customization involved.

items.question: Can I choose the features and technology based on my business requirements?
items.answer: Yes, you can prioritize features and choose suitable technologies with our team based on your business goals, users, scalability needs, and product requirements.

items.question: What factors can influence the overall cost of a development project?
items.answer: The overall cost can vary based on platform selection, feature complexity, UI/UX requirements, integrations, backend architecture, third-party services, and ongoing support.

items.question: What AI development services does AptenTech provide for businesses?
items.answer: AptenTech develops AI-powered applications, chatbots, recommendation systems, automation solutions, intelligent workflows, predictive tools, and custom AI integrations for businesses.

items.question: Can AptenTech integrate AI features into an existing website or application?
items.answer: Yes, AptenTech can integrate AI capabilities into existing products, including chatbots, content generation, recommendations, automation, intelligent search, and AI-powered workflows.

items.question: What types of AI solutions can AptenTech build for different business needs?
items.answer: AptenTech can build conversational AI, recommendation engines, predictive analytics, document intelligence, workflow automation, AI assistants, and other solutions based on business requirements.

items.question: Can AptenTech integrate AI models, APIs, and third-party AI tools into my product?
items.answer: Yes, AptenTech can integrate suitable AI models, APIs, and third-party tools into your application while aligning them with your functionality and technical architecture.

items.question: How can AI help improve operations, customer experiences, and business workflows?
items.answer: AI can automate repetitive tasks, personalize interactions, analyze business data, support decision-making, improve response times, and streamline everyday workflows.
